description: This file provides core functions and utilities for the TestLink open-source test management tool. It includes database connection setup, session management, user rights and access control, configuration handling, templating, and utility functions related to test project and test plan initialization, as well as security measures and external API integrations.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Represents a user within the TestLink system, handling user data and rights, with methods for reading user info, checking rights, and retrieving display names.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Represents a test project, managing project data and access rights for users.

classes.name: tlObjectWithDB
classes.description: Provides static methods for obtaining database table names related to test projects and plans.

methods.name: require_once
methods.description: Includes external PHP files, ensuring they are included only once.

methods.name: spl_autoload_register
methods.description: Registers an autoload function for PHP classes.

methods.name: config_get
methods.description: Retrieves configuration options, with support for default values.

methods.name: tlSetCookie
methods.description: Sets a cookie based on configuration and input object.

methods.name: has_rights
methods.description: Checks if a user has specific rights for a project.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects browser to another URL with optional level (location or refresh).

methods.name: lang_get
methods.description: Retrieves a localized string based on a key.

methods.name: logAuditEvent
methods.description: Logs an audit event for security and activity tracking.

methods.name: get_home_url
methods.description: Returns the base URL of the application.

methods.name: getUserDocumentation
methods.description: Retrieves user documentation links or content.

methods.name: getSecurityNotes
methods.description: Retrieves security notices or warnings.

methods.name: checkForRepositoryDir
methods.description: Checks if a repository directory exists and is accessible.

methods.name: get_object_vars
methods.description: Returns object properties as an array.

methods.name: getEntityByAPIKey
methods.description: Retrieves a database entity (test project or plan) by its API key.

methods.name: hasRight
methods.description: Checks if a user has specific rights within the system.

methods.name: setPaths
methods.description: Sets URL paths for application routing.

methods.name: setDateTimeFormats
methods.description: Configures date/time formats based on locale.

methods.name: session_start
methods.description: Starts a PHP session.

methods.name: memory_get_usage
methods.description: Returns current memory usage.

methods.name: memory_get_peak_usage
methods.description: Returns peak memory usage.

methods.name: file_get_contents
methods.description: Reads entire file into a string.

methods.name: iconv_strlen
methods.description: Returns string length in multi-byte encodings.

methods.name: iconv_substr
methods.description: Returns part of a string in multi-byte encodings.

methods.name: mb_substr
methods.description: Multi-byte safe substring function.

methods.name: clearstatcache
methods.description: Clears cached filesystem status information.
